item.title: Good Morning Family - 20 August 2026
item.description:
Wakey Wakey breakfast crew!
Hello everyone!
Today is Thursday, the 20 August.
Wake up everyone, it’s time to start the day.
. . . . . . . . .
Today looks like a nice calm day.
. . . . . . . . .
In Bendigo today, it will be rainy, with a low of 8 degrees and a top of 15 degrees.
There is about a 37 percent chance of rain.
You might need a warm jumper today.
. . . . . . . . .
Today’s letter is X.
Can you think of something that starts with the letter X?
. . . . . . . . . . . . .
